GWAS result Ommatidia corrected by CS: this file contains the GWAS results from ommatidia number corrected by CS values for a pvalue threshold of 1E-4 (results from Dgrpool https://dgrpool.epfl.ch/ ) GWAS result Ommatidia corrected by tibia length: this file contains the GWAS results from ommatidia number corrected by tibia length values for a pvalue threshold of 1E-4 (results from DGRP website tool) GWAS result PC1 corrected by CS: this file contains the GWAS results from wing shape (mean PC1) corrected by wing size (CS) values for a pvalue threshold of 1E-4 (results from Dgrpool https://dgrpool.epfl.ch/ ) GWAS result PC2 corrected by CS: this file contains the GWAS results from wing shape (mean PC2) corrected by wing size (CS) values for a pvalue threshold of 1E-4 (results from Dgrpool https://dgrpool.epfl.ch/ ) GWAS result- wing shape PC1: this file contains the GWAS results from wing shape (mean of PC1) for a pvalue threshold of 1E-4 (results from DGRP website tool) GWAS result-wing shape PC2: this file contains the GWAS results from wing shape (mean of PC2) for a pvalue threshold of 1E-4 (results from DGRP website tool) GWAS results-Tibia length: this file contains the GWAS results from leg size (tibia length) for a pvalue threshold of 1E-4 (results from DGRP website tool) GWAS result- ommatidia number: this file contains the GWAS results from ommatidia number for a pvalue threshold of 1E-4 (results from DGRP website tool) Ommatidia number data_162strains: phenotypic data of ommatidia number in 162 strains Tibia length -162 strains: phenotypic data of tibia length in 162 strains
